learning_question.en: How do we know every slot in the chosen representation has the same empty meaning without sharing one mutable object?

boundary_case.vi: Theo dõi ô cuối của vùng thứ hai/chiều thứ hai.
boundary_case.en: Track the final slot of the second region/dimension.

failure_case.vi: Bỏ một vùng, sai sentinel hoặc alias mọi ô.

learning_question.vi: Mỗi constructor input/default đi vào field nào?
learning_question.en: Where does each constructor input/default go?

predict_prompt.vi: Kéo từng parameter/default tới field trước reveal.
predict_prompt.en: Route each parameter/default to a field before reveal.

normal_case.vi: Mọi parameter có giá trị khác nhau cùng một default field.
normal_case.en: All parameters are distinct plus one default field.

boundary_case.vi: Default 0/rỗng và slot đầu/cuối của composition.
boundary_case.en: Zero/empty default and first/last composed slot.

failure_case.vi: Đảo parameters hoặc sai mangled/private spelling tạo field lạ.
failure_case.en: Swapped parameters or mangled/private spelling creates a stray field.

representation_and_convention: attribute spelling/case is exact
double underscore implies Python name mangling
constructor parameter order follows the QP
defaults and composed storage are explicit

learning_question.vi: State nào do parent tạo, state nào do subclass tạo?
learning_question.en: Which state is created by the parent and by the subclass?

predict_prompt.vi: Chọn arguments cho super và remaining assignments.
predict_prompt.en: Choose super arguments and remaining assignments.

normal_case.vi: Parent fields xuất hiện sau super, rồi hai fields mới.
normal_case.en: Parent fields appear after super, then two new fields.

boundary_case.vi: Số parent arguments tối thiểu và một subclass-only field.
boundary_case.en: Minimum parent arguments and one subclass-only field.

failure_case.vi: New argument bị gửi vào super và một parent argument được gán hai lần.
failure_case.en: A new argument is passed to super and a parent argument is assigned twice.

representation_and_convention: parent arguments go through the parent constructor
subclass-only fields initialise afterward
super/parent call occurs exactly once

predict_prompt.vi: Dự đoán mọi after-field khi một candidate vượt bound.
predict_prompt.en: Predict every after-field when one candidate exceeds a bound.

normal_case.vi: Old state khác 0 cùng delta/percentage bất đối xứng.
normal_case.en: Non-zero old state plus asymmetric delta/percentage.

boundary_case.vi: Candidate dưới, đúng, vượt bound trong khi secondary field vẫn update.
boundary_case.en: Candidate below, at and above a bound while a secondary field still updates.

failure_case.vi: Replacement, sai dấu/base hoặc early return bỏ secondary field.
failure_case.en: Replacement, wrong sign/base or early return skips another field.

representation_and_convention: candidate is computed from old state
clamp applies on every relevant path
all required fields update even when one reaches a bound

normal_case.en: A partial aggregate stores the exact Train then increments count.

failure_case.en: Increments before store/full guard or returns the wrong Boolean/object identity.

representation_and_convention: count is next free slot in the observed part
full when count equals capacity
failure is non-mutating
store precedes increment
